description.p: Vivid adjusts the colour saturation of each physical display independently on KDE Plasma Wayland. It generates a synthetic ICC profile for the selected output, assigns it through KScreen, and verifies that KWin reports the new per-output colour state before claiming success.

Changing one monitor does not change another. Settings are stored per physical display and restored after login, reboot, or monitor reconnection. Vivid records the original profile assignment before the first change and restores it on reset or uninstall.

Vivid requires KDE Plasma 6 on a native Wayland session, KScreen, KWin, and Little CMS 2. It does not use root privileges, a global shader, xrandr, or a generic sRGB fallback. HDR output is not supported.
Initial release with per-display saturation, recovery, CLI, GUI, and Fedora packaging.
